data.one_liner: Dart package to load JavaScript libraries that use AMD (RequireJS) in web apps.
data.what_it_does: It checks if a native AMD implementation is present and, if not, injects <script> tags to load the library. It also exposes a Dart API to require modules and optionally expose global JS variables.
use_when: You need to use a JS library that relies on AMD in a Dart web project.
You want to avoid script loading conflicts with Dart’s own AMD loader in development mode.
avoid_when: You are building a non-web Dart app (e.g., Flutter mobile).
You already have a native AMD loader like RequireJS included manually.
strengths: Handles both native AMD and fallback script injection.
Supports async loading and global variable exposure.
Well tested with integration tests against RequireJS.
weaknesses: Only works on web; no support for mobile or desktop Flutter.
Requires manual script paths or package names; not a code generator.
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import 'package:amdjs/amdjs.dart'; no build_runner needed.
